headline: Daikin Industries Raises Full-Year Profit Guidance
summary: Daikin Industries has increased its full-year profit guidance following a sales beat in the most recent quarter.
why: Guidance revisions are critical for investors to adjust earnings models and valuation expectations for the company.

impacts.name: Daikin Industries
impacts.why: Higher profit guidance directly improves the company's valuation outlook.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Upward revisions to profit guidance generally trigger positive price action as earnings expectations are adjusted higher.
